title: Volumetric, acoustic, and computational investigation of L-threonine and glycyl-L-threonine interactions in aqueous 1-octyl-3-methylimidazolium bromide solutions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30026-30051
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01144F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ravinder Sharma, Sandeep Kumar, Marc Mulamba Tshibangu, Indra Bahadur
The study investigates the thermodynamic properties and molecular interactions of L-threonine and glycyl-L-threonine in aqueous 1-octyl-3-methylimidazolium bromide [OMIm][Br] solutions from 288.15 to 318.15 K.
